_about: Her horse (scripts/horse.gd, 2026-11-26: Alex wants a horse she can ride to get places faster; a placeholder until there are Tripo models again). Lars sells it once Act 1 is done (price). G gets on when it's within mount_reach metres, and off again; from further away G whistles it over (within call_reach). Riding, her walk and run are speed times faster. It's the dog's model scaled up and tinted (model, scale, tint): a STAND-IN until a horse is made. saddle: how high she sits. It never herds. Every number and line is a DRAFT.
name: Chestnut
line: She's an old cob, but she'll go all day. Feed her, brush her, don't race her up the foothills.
